commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+7' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes shows a yellow card to Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) for his blatant foul.
90+6' Alvaro Aguado (Espanyol) takes the free kick from the edge of the box but the defensive wall makes the block.
90+6' A free kick on the edge of the box for Espanyol. Let's see if they'll manage to convert it into a goal.
90+5' Espanyol will take a corner kick.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Raul Moro (Valladolid) dribbles into the box, but Joan Garcia is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
87' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Irvin Cardona (Espanyol) was quite harsh and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
87' Valladolid are ruled offside.
82' Here's the change. Eray Comert leaves the pitch and David Torres (Valladolid) comes on as a substitute.
82' Paulo Pezzolano decides to make a substitution. Kike Perez will be replaced by Chuki (Valladolid).
81' Javi Puado (Espanyol) homes in on a magnificent reverse pass from Alex Kral and strikes a crisp shot goalwards that just misses the left post.
80' Lucas Rosa (Valladolid) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
79' It will be a substitution. Alvaro Aguado (Espanyol) is ready to enter the pitch as Jose Gragera walks off.
77' The referee blows for a cooling break.
77' Irvin Cardona (Espanyol) gets there first and whips in a shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.
75' Raul Moro (Valladolid) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
74' The corner is swung in but Valladolid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
72' Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) has tested the patience of referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
70' The substitution has been made. Jofre (Espanyol) has replaced Alvaro Tejero.
70' Here is a change. Alejo Veliz is going off and Manolo Gonzalez gives the last tactical orders to Antoniu Roca (Espanyol).
70' Substitution. Selim Amallah makes way for Victor Andres Meseguer Cavas (Valladolid).
69' Paulo Pezzolano has decided to make a change. Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) replaces Amath Ndiaye.
65' Amath Ndiaye (Valladolid) sends a cross into the box, but Joan Garcia comes off his line to gather the ball.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Stanko Juric (Valladolid) replaces Javier Sanchez.
61' Valladolid are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
61' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows for a foul after Jose Gragera (Espanyol) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
60' Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
59' Lucas Rosa (Valladolid) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
58' Alex Kral (Espanyol) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
57' Manolo Gonzalez prepares a substitution. Pol Lozano is replaced by Alex Kral (Espanyol).
57' The game has come to an end for Pere Milla. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Irvin Cardona (Espanyol).
52' Sergi Gomez (Espanyol) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and sends a shot to the middle of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Karl Hein.
49' Javier Sanchez (Valladolid) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
49' Javier Sanchez (Valladolid) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
46' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+4' Javi Puado (Espanyol) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
45+3' What a chance that is! Amath Ndiaye (Valladolid) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header crashes off the crossbar!
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' That's unlucky! Selim Amallah (Valladolid) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
43' Selim Amallah (Valladolid) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar.
42' Luis Perez (Valladolid) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
40' Luis Perez (Valladolid) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
35' Valladolid are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block.
30' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
29' Espanyol earn a corner.
29' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Alejo Veliz (Espanyol), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
27' Raul Moro (Valladolid) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.

23' 1 - 0 GOAL 1:0! Raul Moro (Valladolid) brilliantly slaloms his way forward past a few defenders and unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which is deflected and goes into the back of the net.
21' The ball possession at the moment is 62:38.
16' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Valladolid comes to nothing.
14' Eray Comert (Valladolid) unleashes a shot towards goal from a promising position, but one of the defenders makes an important interception with a header.
14' The ball goes out for a corner. Valladolid can continue in their attacking effort.
11' Joan Garcia displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Amath Ndiaye (Valladolid) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
10' Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
9' Amath Ndiaye (Valladolid) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
4' One of the players from Valladolid times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
3' Alejo Veliz (Espanyol) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
2' Alejo Veliz (Espanyol) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Valladolid will kick the game off.
Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes will referee today's match.
